summary: EDNS(0) lets a DNS receiver signal how large a UDP message it accepts, enabling large responses, but large UDP messages are more likely to be fragmented, and IP fragmentation has exposed weaknesses. This informational document describes ways to avoid fragmentation in DNS over UDP.

eli5.summary: Big packages get chopped into pieces that can be lost or tampered with. This gives tips for keeping DNS answers small enough to travel whole.

questions: how to avoid ip fragmentation in dns
